# Checks that are known to fail, and the issue that will close each one.
#
# A check listed here is reported as `xfail` and does not fail the job. A check
# listed here that starts passing is reported as `XPASS` and does fail the job,
# so a fix cannot land without this file being updated in the same breath. That
# is the whole point: without it, either the run is permanently red and a new
# regression hides in the noise, or the known bugs get quietly dropped from the
# harness and stop being tracked at all.
#
# Columns: id, platform, issue number, note.
# Platform is one of: all, unix, windows, linux, macos.

# #70 Windows does not set HOME, so the store home never resolves.
cli/env/native-shell-index      windows   70   no HOME, so the store home never resolves
portal/env/native-shell-index   windows   70   the same failure from the CLI side

# #71 The portal's directory browser falls back to the filesystem root.
portal/dirs/home-is-user-home   windows   71   reports the drive root as the home directory
portal/dirs/browse-repo         windows   71   refuses the user profile as outside home

# #73 home() writes into the working directory rather than erroring.
portal/env/no-store-in-cwd      windows   73   a store is written where the installer ran
portal/env/no-cache-in-cwd      windows   73   52 MB of weights land in the working directory

# #74 Windows locators are printed as \\?\ verbatim paths.
cli/files/no-verbatim-paths     windows   74   canonicalize returns the verbatim form
cli/search/no-verbatim-paths    windows   74   same prefix on every hit
cli/read/span                   windows   74   a corpus-relative target does not resolve
cli/read/line                   windows   74   the same, for path:line
cli/read/json                   windows   74   the same, for --json
portal/search/no-verbatim       windows   74   the same prefix through the portal

# #75 Printing to a closed pipe panics rather than exiting. All three
# platforms: SIGPIPE is the unix mechanism, but the Windows write error
# reaches the same panic in println!.
cli/pipe/survives-truncation    all       75   panics instead of exiting quietly

# #76 A path that cannot be read still creates and registers a store.
cli/index/missing-registers-nothing  all   76   an empty store is left behind

# #77 forget removes nothing and still exits 0.
cli/forget/removes                   all   77   the file is still listed afterwards
portal/forget/removes                all   77   the same route, the same no-op

# #78 The search route validates an offset it never applies.
portal/search/offset                 all   78   offset=1 returns the same hit
